title: The boulder rolls at twice its speed
description: The player has taken the golden idol, and the tiki head drops a boulder that crushes him. It rolls off to the right at 8 and 10 pixels on alternate steps, twice the 4.5 its code sets, and slows as it rolls on toward the wall.
